evidence.quote: The legal duration of the Degree Program is 3 years.
The pre-enrolment application is made exclusively through the Universitaly portal (visit https://www.universitaly.it/studenti-stranieri).
it is stated that the diploma has been obtained after at least 12 years of pre-university education
Both non-EU and EU candidate students should provide evidence of English language proficiency at B2 or higher level (CEFR level).

note.fr: Test d'admission sélectif obligatoire (English TOLC-I du CISIA), à passer à distance après inscription sur le site du CISIA ; le test est répétable. Score minimum de 20 % requis.
note.en: Compulsory selective admission test (CISIA English TOLC-I), taken remotely after registering on the CISIA website; the test is repeatable. Minimum score of 20% required.

evidence.quote: Personal preparation is ascertained by means of a compulsory selective test, required for admission to the Degree Program, that is entrusted to the CISIA Consortium (English TOLC-I).

note.fr: Vérifier si un diplôme marocain est admis et si une procédure de vérification auprès de CIMEA/ENIC-NARIC est exigée ; contacter le coordinateur du cursus (Prof. Francesca Pagliara).
note.en: Check whether a Moroccan diploma is accepted and whether a CIMEA/ENIC-NARIC verification procedure is required; contact the programme coordinator (Prof. Francesca Pagliara).

evidence.quote: You have to produce any documentation that the University deems necessary for the evaluation of the foreign qualification:
Contact person for International Students: Prof. Francesca Pagliara (DICEA), phone no.: 081 7683932

notes: Tuition left out: the only fee figures on the pages (€140/year regional fee + €16.00 legal stamp for non-European students, €200/year tuition for European students) are the regional tax and the stamp duty, not the tuition fee, and no page gives a tuition figure for a non-EU applicant with a household abroad (Morocco). The application deadline for 2026/27 (15 June 2026) was not included because it is the general pre-enrolment deadline and no quote states it is for non-EU or foreign-qualification applicants; the national visa deadlines (30 November, 31 October) are visa deadlines, not application deadlines. The B2 English requirement is worded as "should provide evidence", so it is listed as a requirement rule but flagged as soft wording; admission is by the compulsory CISIA English TOLC-I test.
